_comment: The weapon table. Entries must be in WeaponId order (Punch, Glock, Ak47,
RocketLauncher) and named, so a file that drifts out of step with the protocol
says so at load instead of quietly mixing weapons up.
Damage, cooldown, priority and the spread model are HAND-AUTHORED balance -
edit them here. The muzzle fields are MEASURED: run
KnockKnock > Export Weapon Muzzles to weapons.json and it rewrites this file,
keeping your balance edits and replacing only those two numbers per weapon.
Spread bloom (firearms): current spread = baseSpreadDeg + bloom, where bloom
grows by spreadPerShotDeg per shot, is capped at maxSpreadDeg, and recovers at
spreadRecoveryDegPerSec. Melee weapons use meleeRangeMeters and meleeArcDeg.
muzzleForwardMeters/muzzleRightMeters place a PROJECTILE weapon's muzzle
relative to the player's centre, in the player's own frame. The sideways one
matters: the weapon is held in a hand, off to one side, so a rocket fired from
the centre appears beside the barrel. Hitscan weapons do not need them - those
are judged from the centre and only drawn from the barrel.
